deep.reconstruction:
This is a personal memorandum page. It contains no mathematical derivation, only bookkeeping and notes.

(1) Salary note (German). "According to the notification of Mr. Lahmeyer[?] to Hofrath Himly of 25 February 1836, the salary of the Director of the Societät der Wissenschaften is paid half-yearly with 25 Rthlr. in gold and 30 Rthlr. 11 gGr. in Courant." A word before "Societät" is struck through; the transcription reads it as "Sternw[arte]", which I cannot confirm from the image. My addition: the annual total is 50 Rthlr. gold plus 60 Rthlr. 22 gGr. Courant. Gauss held the rotating directorship of the Göttingen Society at times; Himly was its secretary/treasurer.

(2) List of securities. These appear to be bonds or lottery bonds identified by series letter and number. Each has a nominal value (10, 10, 5, 5, 5, 5, 20, 5; total 65) and markers.
- Marked ⊙: A670 (10), B216 (10), C87 (5), F10402 (5), H846 (20), L1437 (5). Their sum is 55.
- F501b (5) is marked '(5%)' instead.
- H135 (5) has no ⊙.
- Starred *: B216, F10402, H846, summing to 10+5+20 = 35.
- Marked |**: C87 and H135.

(3) Small table: 55 | 42 'furent'; 20 | 10 'resteront'; 15 | 5 'resteront'. My reading of the first column, which is consistent with the list:
- 55 is the ⊙-total that 'were' held.
- Removing the starred items gives 55 - 35 = 20 'will remain' (A 10, C 5, L 5).
- Removing the **-marked C87 (5) gives 15 (A 10, L 5).

The second column (42, 10, 5) is unexplained. It is not proportional to the first, so it may be values in another unit or a second holding. This interpretation is mine and uncertain.

(4) Baden state bonds held by the writer's mother-in-law (Schwiegermutter), dated 5 July 1847: nos. 13409, 16346, 16347, 16348.

(5) A French excerpt on Daguerre's new processes: 'they are distinguished by economy, a kind of merit which, incidentally, rarely goes together with perfection of the products'. This is very probably copied from Arago's 1839 report on the daguerreotype (not verified).
errors: Second column of the small table (42, 10, 5) does not follow from the list's nominal values by any evident rule. It is not necessarily an error, but it is unexplained.

The struck-out word before 'Societät' is uncertain in the image; 'Sternw' is not clearly supported.
'Schwiegermutter 1847 Jul 5.' is confirmed; the bond numbers 13409, 16346, 16347, 16348 read correctly.
